caption:
Thursday's Sky is Yin Water, The Rain and Mist 🌧️ Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's soft rain meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Water gets a friend day, Yin Metal gets a joy day, Yin Fire feels a small squeeze.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which one sounds like your Thursday? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #zodiacsigns #knowyourself #fengshui #fourpillars #chineseastrology #dailyhoroscope #singapore
day_line: Rain and mist on a Goat day. Soft and gentle: good for quiet thinking and kind words, easy to drift off course.

lines.Yang Wood: A wise word lands today. Write it down before the next meeting starts.
lines.Yin Wood: Rainy-day thinking suits you. Your best idea turns up on the bus home.
lines.Yang Fire: People look to you today. Lead the meeting and keep it under 30 minutes.
lines.Yin Fire: A small deadline pinches today. Start early; skip the second coffee break.
lines.Yang Earth: Steady wins today. Finish the task you keep pushing to tomorrow.
lines.Yin Earth: A lucky break may show up today. Read the details before you jump.
lines.Yang Metal: Your opinions are sharp today. Share one; save the rest for lunch.
lines.Yin Metal: Small pleasures hit hard today. Get the good bubble tea, full sugar.
lines.Yang Water: Someone wants the same seat today. Share the table; it's not a race.
lines.Yin Water: Your people get you today. Send the voice note; they'll reply fast.
